comment: The parallel charges' force, the magnetism row (b2) of ALGEBRA.md #the-rows-against-nature, designed in the rotation round and to be run (ENGINE.md, section 6): the force between two like charges moving side by side over the static force, nature's Coulomb over gamma, read on the GameBoard as the transverse separation's second difference.
